categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed information about land parcel numbers, owners, extents, and property rights. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, property ownership, and land titles.
